item.coloph: de ltar rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro yi/ gsol 'debs dag la brten nas su/ mchog thun dngos grub zhu thabs 'di/ ma sring thugs bcud yin gsungs/ ma nges sprang po rnal 'byor gyis/ ma sring zhal gyi gdam pa'i bon/ zangs 'brug 'khyil pa'i ri rtse ru/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa yin/ mkha' 'gro gnyen la bzod par gsol/ dar rgyas 'phel ba'i bkra shis shog/
